mapper.select: SELECT I.INQR_SN, I.USER_SN, I.INQR_TYPE_CD, I.INQR_TTL, I.INQR_CN, I.PRVT_PST_YN, I.ANS_STTS_CD, I.PSTG_STTS_CD, I.PSTG_STTS_RSN, I.REG_DT, U.USER_NM AS WRITER_NM FROM INQR_INFO I JOIN USER_ACNT U ON U.USER_SN = I.USER_SN WHERE I.INQR_SN = #{inqrSn} AND I.DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT INQR_SN, USER_SN, PRVT_PST_YN, ANS_STTS_CD, PSTG_STTS_CD, DEL_YN FROM INQR_INFO WHERE INQR_SN = #{inqrSn} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: I.INQR_SN, I.INQR_TYPE_CD, I.PRVT_PST_YN, I.ANS_STTS_CD, I.PSTG_STTS_CD, I.REG_DT, CASE WHEN I.PRVT_PST_YN = 'Y' AND I.USER_SN <> #{viewerSn} AND #{isOperator} = 'N' THEN NULL ELSE I.INQR_TTL END AS INQR_TTL, CASE WHEN I.PRVT_PST_YN = 'Y' AND I.USER_SN <> #{viewerSn} AND #{isOperator} = 'N' THEN NULL ELSE U.USER_NM END AS WRITER_NM, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQR_ANS_INFO A WHERE A.INQR_SN = I.INQR_SN AND A.DEL_YN = 'N') AS ANSWER_CNT
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM INQR_INFO I JOIN USER_ACNT U ON U.USER_SN = I.USER_SN
ORDER BY I.INQR_SN DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE INQR_INFO SET PSTG_STTS_CD = 'BLINDED', PSTG_STTS_RSN = #{pstgSttsRsn}, MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE INQR_SN = #{inqrSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND PSTG_STTS_CD = 'NORMAL'
UPDATE INQR_INFO SET PSTG_STTS_CD = 'NORMAL', PSTG_STTS_RSN = NULL, MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE INQR_SN = #{inqrSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND PSTG_STTS_CD = 'BLINDED'
mapper.select: SELECT A.ANS_SN, A.INQR_SN, A.ANS_USER_SN, A.ANS_CN, A.REG_DT, U.USER_NM AS ANSR_NM FROM INQR_ANS_INFO A JOIN USER_ACNT U ON U.USER_SN = A.ANS_USER_SN WHERE A.INQR_SN = #{inqrSn} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY A.REG_DT, A.ANS_SN
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQR_ANS_INFO WHERE INQR_SN = #{inqrSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMM_CD WHERE GROUP_CD = 'INQR_TYPE' AND CD = #{inqrTypeCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N'
